title: 第12章  极尽升华，武道极境！
content_zh:
“方玄，他竟然登上四楼了！”
全场响起成片惊呼声。
显然他们也没想到，方玄真的能够登上武楼四层。
武楼挑战确实不看境界修为，只会根据挑战者个人的潜力，派出与之实力相匹配的妖兽。
但在挑战过程中，若是自身实力不足，也根本无法完成挑战。
方玄能够冲上四楼，这意味着，他的武道潜力不输普通天才。
“不对啊，这方玄虽然身负先天道体，但我听说他曾经遭受意外，修为尽废，连先天道体也一并失去了，他是如何做到的？”
“难道他作弊？”
有人提出这个猜测。
“扯呢！”
这话立即遭到反驳：“武楼创建不知道多少年，还没听说过谁能在武楼中作弊呢。”
“不错。再怎么说，这方玄都曾是青阳郡第一天才，有些手段也很正常。”
有人冷笑道：“而且，不过是武楼四层罢了，普通天才都能做到，算不得什么。”
“也是。相对方玄，我更看好苏晨，他之前挑战武楼，最好的成绩就是四层，如今突破到炼体境，怕是要打破曾经的记录了。”
闻言，方雨容神情愈发紧张。
方玄，你这个浑蛋，一定要赢啊。
她恼怒方玄冲动，贸然和苏晨定下赌约。
但无论如何，同为方家人。
她自然不愿意看到方玄输。
“你们看，苏晨上五楼了。”

就在此时，苏晨的名字后面，浮现一个五字。
这让方雨容更加紧张，手心发汗，脸色微白。
仅仅在五楼停留了半刻钟时间，苏晨就冲上了六楼，打破之前的记录，突破自我。
但只坚持了一瞬，苏晨的名字就暗淡下去。
挑战六楼失败。
但登上六楼，就能石碑留名。
整个青阳郡，能够做到这一步的，可不多。
“苏晨赢了。”
“果然，那方玄痴傻三年，终是天才陨落，不如苏晨。”
“他冒犯苏清瑶，本就该死。”
等到苏晨走出武楼，看到方玄的名字，还停留在四楼，嘴角顿时掀起一抹得意的弧度。
方玄啊方玄，就算你大难不死又如何？
今日当着这么多人的面，照样取你性命！
所有人，包括方雨容在内。
都以为方玄输定了。
只有一人，盯着方玄的名字，陷入沉思。
那就是李天骄。
“奇怪，以方玄哥哥的实力，应该不至于停留这么久才对。”
......
武楼幻境。

三十六头毒刺甲牛，从四面八方，冲向方玄。
方玄双眸恢复平静，但周身杀意，却更加凌厉。
好似要将这武楼幻境直接冲破。
“热身结束，真正的挑战，开始了！”
只见方玄双手结印，整个人的气势蓦地一变。
方玄的体内，散发出一股混沌之气，席卷四周，笼罩整个平原。
衣衫猎猎，黑发狂舞。
眼中金芒绽放，混沌圣体开启！
“杀道王拳，破！”
在三十六头毒刺甲牛靠近身前一米范围之时，方玄五指握拳，狠狠砸在地上。
“轰隆隆！”
以方玄拳头为中心，地面裂开，平原翻滚。
恐怖的杀伐之力，形成一道道冲击波，朝着四周席卷。
“嘭嘭嘭！”
每当有毒刺甲牛靠近，就被杀伐之力搅碎。
等到方玄站起身，三十六头毒刺甲牛，已经死得干干净净。
所有气血，尽数钻入方玄体内。
石碑上的数字，由四变五。
与此同时，七十二头毒刺甲牛，再次从四周狂奔而来。
方玄嘴角一掀，在牛群靠近的瞬间，又是一拳轰出。

七十二头毒刺甲牛，顿时被瞬间秒杀。
武楼之外。
当看到方玄，登上五楼之时，惊呼声如同海啸一般，差点掀翻整座武楼。
方雨容面露欣喜。
苏晨则是眉头微皱。
只有李天骄知道，这才刚开始。
前后不过一个呼吸的功夫，方玄就成功登上六楼。
全场顿时陷入死一般的寂静。
连方雨容都震惊的张大红唇，满脸震撼。
唯有苏晨，死死的攥紧拳头，五官扭曲。
“怎么可能！他怎么可能登上六楼！”
要知道，他可是炼体境的武者啊，足足高出方玄一个大境界。
但好在，方玄登上六楼，也只是和他打成平手。
谁都没输，谁也没赢。
石碑上，方玄的名字飞速闪烁。
根据经验，这是挑战失败的征兆。
但是下一刻，方玄名字后面的数字，瞬间由六变成了七！
“不，这不可能！”
苏晨直接尖叫出声。
然而，让苏晨更加震撼的一幕出现了。

方玄仅仅在七楼停顿了两息时间，就直接登上了八楼。
“八楼？”
看着那个刺眼的名字，所有人早已被震惊得无以复加。
方雨容，早已满脸呆滞。
方玄，登上武楼八楼了？
方玄赢了！
不仅赢了，而且赢得十分精彩。
八楼对六楼，完全就是碾压啊。
方雨容脸上，不由得绽放出一抹笑容，彻底放下心来。
虽然方玄的表现，令她也感到无比震撼。
但至少，他赢了。
自始至终，唯有李天骄相信，方玄绝不会输。
她眼眸中，异彩连连。
曾经那个如骄阳耀眼，镇压同代的方玄哥哥，回来了。
就在李天骄以为，方玄的挑战就此结束之时，武楼幻境，八楼之中。
方玄矗立在平原之上。
周身被一片气血潮汐笼罩。
九转金丹，正在疯狂炼化这些气血。
“嗡！”
“嗡！”

“嗡！”
奈何这些气血之力太过浓厚，连九转金丹一时间都无法完全吸收。
而数百头体型如同山岳，模样更为狰狞的毒刺甲牛，脚踏大地，狂奔而来。
这数百头毒刺甲牛，已然二阶。
相当于，数百个炼体境武者！
“快一点，再快一点！”
方玄双手结印，疯狂运转混沌圣体，将周身的气血之力炼化。
“嗷吼！”
但是二阶毒刺甲牛的速度太快了，直接将方玄撞飞出去。
不等方玄落地，又是两头毒刺甲牛前后夹击，准备将方玄生生撞碎。
“止步八楼了吗？”
方玄嘴角溢血，脸色狰狞。
“我不甘心！”
方玄怒吼一声：“给我炼！”
两道金色光束，自方玄眼中绽放而出，洞穿虚空。
而方玄周身的混沌气息，瞬间抵达顶点，将两头二阶毒刺甲牛碾碎。
方玄的身体极速坠落，但在下坠过程中，方玄神情平静。
五指张开，化作一掌，朝着下方轻轻一按。
“执掌太初，混沌无尽！”
体内气血、混沌之气，包括自身意念，全部灌注到这一掌之中。

“破！”
当声音落下之时，广袤的平原，顿时狠狠颤抖了一下。
数百头毒刺甲牛，如同被一只无形手掌，尽数抹除。
滚滚气血，铺天盖地的灌注到方玄的体内，让他感到周身胀痛，像是随时可能爆开。
“轰隆隆！”
在完成八楼的挑战之时，大地开裂，道道血光，冲霄而起。
一具具白骨，从裂缝中翻滚而出，堆积成山。
如同修罗炼狱。
在那骨山之上，矗立着一道身影。
红衣白发，眉心染血。
除了气质不同，相貌和方玄，如出一辙。
而在看到对方的瞬间，方玄心神大震。
因为，他竟然从对方身上，看到了九帝传承。
他，就是另一个自己！
他居高临下的看着方玄，猩红的双眸中，有的只是纯粹的杀意。
“战胜我，可破境。”
他缓缓抬起手臂，五指依次张开，朝方玄一掌按来。
“执掌修罗，以杀证道！”
明明和刚才方玄那一掌一模一样，然而气息却完全不同。
无边血气，在红衣白发方玄身后凝聚，化作一道巍峨法身，朝着方玄一掌拍来。

就像是一尊真正的上古杀神，朝凡间打出一道血色巨掌，欲摧毁万界。
这一刻，方玄竟然感受到一抹生死危机。
接不住这一击，他会死！
不是挑战失败，而是包括肉身、神魂，所有关于他的一切，都会彻底消失在世间。
真正意义上的死亡。
方玄心脏跳动。
那是对死亡的恐惧。
无法摆脱，无法压制。
这是万物生灵的本能。
在那血色巨掌越来越近的时候，方玄反而释然了。
他没有多余的动作。
仅仅只是抬起手臂，朝着上方，轰出一拳。
方玄身后，同样凝聚出一道风华绝代的身影。
惊天杀意，充斥万界。
相比白发方玄身后的杀神法身，方玄身后的这道身影，才是真正的杀神本尊。
执掌杀伐之道！
这正是方玄根据白发方玄以意念，勾勒出来的杀神女帝幻影。
方玄好似与杀神女帝幻影融为一体，齐齐抬手，轰出一拳。
“杀神、降临！”
一拳出，风云变色，血雷齐落。

血色巨掌，如积雪被骄阳融化，寸寸消散。
骨山被直接粉碎。
血海也被轰成齑粉。
白发方玄身后的法身，被一拳打成虚无。
天地，安静了。
平原之上，方玄与白发方玄两两对视。
“败了啊。”
白发方玄长叹一声，看了一眼方玄，说了一句意味深长的话，然后缓缓消散。
“我在前方等你。”
当白发方玄消失的瞬间，满天气血前仆后继的涌入方玄体内，冲刷着方玄的四肢百骸。
“咔嚓！”
直到某一刻。
方玄体内传出一声轻响，如同某个桎梏被打破，传遍千万里。
“咚咚咚咚咚咚咚咚咚！”
九道震颤寰宇，却又只有方玄能够听到的洪钟大吕声，在方玄识海中回荡。
“极尽升华，武道极境！”
当这八个大字响起的瞬间，苍穹裂开。
十条金色苍龙，自裂开的天幕中，依次钻入方玄体内，以霸道蛮横的姿态，钻入方玄的九转金丹之中。
方玄闭上双眼，感受着身体的变化。
他的修为，直接突破造血境九重。

霎时间，方玄像是进入了某个玄奥的境地。
五感升华，肉身强化，实力倍增。
“这就是武道极境么，真是玄妙。”
content_en:
"Fang Xuan, he actually climbed to the fourth floor!"
The entire audience burst into exclamations.
Obviously they didn't expect that Fang Xuan could really climb to the fourth floor of the Martial Building.
The Wulou challenge does not depend on the realm of cultivation. It will only send out monsters that match the challenger's strength based on his personal potential.
But during the challenge, if you are not strong enough, you will not be able to complete the challenge at all.
Fang Xuan was able to rush to the fourth floor, which meant that his martial arts potential was not inferior to that of ordinary geniuses.
"That's not right. Although Fang Xuan has an innate Taoist body, I heard that he suffered an accident and his cultivation was completely ruined. He also lost his innate Taoist body. How did he do it?"
"Did he cheat?"
Someone made this speculation.
"That's bullshit!"
This statement was immediately rebutted: "I don't know how many years have passed since the establishment of the martial arts building, but I have never heard of anyone cheating in the martial arts building."
"Not bad. After all, Fang Xuandu was once the number one genius in Qingyang County, and some of his methods are quite normal."
Someone sneered: "Besides, it's just the fourth floor of the Martial Arts Building. Ordinary geniuses can do it, so it's nothing."
"Yes. Compared to Fang Xuan, I am more optimistic about Su Chen. His best result in the Martial Tower challenge before was the fourth level. Now that he has broken through to the Body Refining Realm, I am afraid he will break the previous record."
Hearing this, Fang Yurong looked increasingly nervous.
Fang Xuan, you bastard, you must win.
She was angry that Fang Xuan was impulsive and rashly made a bet with Su Chen.
But no matter what, we are all members of the Fang family.
Naturally, she didn't want to see Fang Xuan lose.
"Look, Su Chen has gone to the fifth floor."
At this moment, a five-character word appeared behind Su Chen's name.
This made Fang Yurong even more nervous, his palms became sweaty and his face turned pale.
After only staying on the fifth floor for half a quarter of an hour, Su Chen rushed to the sixth floor, breaking the previous record and breaking through himself.
But he only persisted for a moment, and Su Chen's name dimmed.
Failed to challenge the sixth floor.
But when you climb to the sixth floor, you can leave your name on the stone tablet.
In the entire Qingyang County, there are not many people who can do this.
"Su Chen won."
"Sure enough, that Fang Xuan was stupid for three years and finally fell as a genius. He is not as good as Su Chen."
"He offended Su Qingyao and deserved to die."
When Su Chen walked out of the Wu Building and saw Fang Xuan's name still on the fourth floor, the corner of his mouth suddenly curled up with a hint of pride.
Fang Xuan, Fang Xuan, so what if you survive the disaster?
Today, in front of so many people, I will still take your life!
Everyone, including Fang Yurong.
Everyone thought that Fang Xuan was destined to lose.
There was only one person, staring at Fang Xuan's name, lost in thought.
That is Li Tianjiao.
"It's strange. With Brother Fang Xuan's strength, he shouldn't be able to stay for so long."
...
The fantasy of Wulou.
Thirty-six stinging armored cattle rushed towards Fang Xuan from all directions.
Fang Xuan's eyes returned to calmness, but the killing intent around him became even more fierce.
It seemed as if he wanted to break through the illusion of the martial arts building directly.
"The warm-up is over and the real challenge begins!"
I saw Fang Xuan forming seals with his hands, and his whole aura suddenly changed.
Fang Xuan's body exuded a chaotic energy, sweeping around and covering the entire plain.
The clothes are shabby, and the black hair is dancing wildly.
The golden light blooms in the eyes, and the Chaos Holy Body is opened!
"Killing Dao King Fist, break!"
When thirty-six poisonous stinging armored cattle approached one meter in front of him, Fang Xuan clenched his fist with five fingers and smashed it on the ground.
"Boom!"
Centered on Fang Xuan's fist, the ground cracked and the plain rolled.
The terrifying killing power formed shock waves that swept around.
"Bang bang bang!"
Whenever the venomous armored cow comes near, it will be broken into pieces by the force of killing.
When Fang Xuan stood up, the thirty-six poisonous-stinged armored cattle were all dead.
All the energy and blood penetrated into Fang Xuan's body.
The number on the stone tablet changed from four to five.
At the same time, seventy-two poisonous-stinged armored cattle came running from all around again.
Fang Xuan raised the corner of his mouth, the moment the cattle approached, he punched out again.
Seventy-two poisonous stinging armored cattle were instantly killed.
Outside the martial arts building.
When he saw Fang Xuan and climbed to the fifth floor, the screams were like a tsunami, almost overturning the entire martial arts building.
Fang Yurong looked happy.
Su Chen frowned slightly.
Only Li Tianjiao knew that this was just the beginning.
In just one breath, Fang Xuan successfully climbed to the sixth floor.
The whole place suddenly fell into deathly silence.
Even Fang Yurong opened her red lips in shock, her face full of shock.
Only Su Chen clenched his fists tightly and his facial features were distorted.
"How is it possible! How could he get to the sixth floor!"
You know, he is a warrior in the body refining realm, a level higher than Fang Xuan.
But fortunately, when Fang Xuan climbed to the sixth floor, he was only tied with him.
No one loses, no one wins.
On the stone tablet, Fang Xuan's name flashed rapidly.
As a rule of thumb, this is a sign of a failed challenge.
But the next moment, the number behind Fang Xuan's name instantly changed from six to seven!
"No, that's impossible!"
Su Chen screamed directly.
However, a scene that shocked Su Chen even more appeared.
Fang Xuan only paused for two breaths on the seventh floor before going straight to the eighth floor.
"Eighth floor?"
Looking at that dazzling name, everyone was already shocked beyond measure.
Fang Yurong's face was already dull.
Fang Xuan, have you climbed to the eighth floor of Wu Tower?
Fang Xuan won!
Not only did he win, but he won brilliantly.
The eighth floor versus the sixth floor was a complete crush.
Fang Yurong couldn't help but burst into a smile, feeling completely relieved.
Although Fang Xuan's performance made her feel extremely shocked.
But at least, he won.
From beginning to end, only Li Tianjiao believed that Fang Xuan would never lose.
There were many brilliant lights in her eyes.
Brother Fang Xuan, who once dazzled like the sun and suppressed his contemporaries, is back.
Just when Li Tianjiao thought that Fang Xuan's challenge was over, the Martial Tower Illusion was on the eighth floor.
Fang Xuan stands on the plain.
The whole body was enveloped by a tide of energy and blood.
The Nine Turns Golden Pill is frantically refining these qi and blood.
"Buzz!"
"Buzz!"
"Buzz!"
However, the power of these qi and blood is too strong, and even the Nine Transformations Golden Pill cannot be completely absorbed for a while.
Hundreds of poisonous-spiked armored cattle, which were as big as mountains and more ferocious in appearance, stamped their feet on the ground and ran towards them.
These hundreds of stinging armored cattle are already at the second level.
Equivalent to hundreds of Body Refining Realm warriors!
"Faster, faster!"
Fang Xuan formed seals with his hands and circulated the Chaos Holy Body crazily, refining the power of Qi and blood all over his body.
"Ouch!"
But the speed of the second-level poisonous stinger armored cow was too fast, and it directly knocked Fang Xuan away.
Before Fang Xuan could land, two more poisonous-stinged armored bulls attacked him from the front and back, preparing to smash Fang Xuan into pieces.
"Have you stopped on the eighth floor?"
Fang Xuan's mouth was bleeding and his face was ferocious.
"I'm not willing to give in!"
Fang Xuan roared angrily: "Practice it for me!"
Two golden beams of light bloomed from Fang Xuan's eyes, piercing the void.
And the chaotic aura around Fang Xuan reached its peak in an instant, crushing two second-level poisonous stinger armored cattle.
Fang Xuan's body fell rapidly, but during the fall, Fang Xuan looked calm.
The five fingers spread out, turned into a palm, and pressed down gently.
"In charge of the beginning, endless chaos!"
The qi, blood and chaotic energy in the body, including his own thoughts, are all poured into this palm.
"Broken!"
When the sound fell, the vast plain suddenly trembled violently.
Hundreds of poisonous stinging armored cattle were wiped out as if by an invisible hand.
The billowing energy and blood poured overwhelmingly into Fang Xuan's body, making him feel swelling and pain all over his body, as if he might explode at any time.
"Boom!"
When he completed the challenge on the eighth floor, the ground cracked open and streaks of blood rose into the sky.
White bones tumbled out of the cracks and piled up into mountains.Like Shura Purgatory.
On top of the Bone Mountain, a figure stood.
Red clothes, white hair, eyebrows stained with blood.
Apart from the difference in temperament, his appearance is exactly the same as Fang Xuan's.
The moment he saw the other party, Fang Xuan was shocked.
Because, he actually saw the inheritance of the Nine Emperors from the other party.
He is another self!
He looked down at Fang Xuan, his scarlet eyes filled with pure murderous intent.
"Beat me and you can break through."
He slowly raised his arm, opened his five fingers one after another, and pressed his palm towards Fang Xuan.
"Take charge of Shura and prove the Tao through killing!"
It was obviously exactly the same as Fang Xuan's palm just now, but the aura was completely different.
Boundless blood energy gathered behind Fang Xuan in red clothes and white hair, turned into a majestic Dharma Body, and slapped Fang Xuan with a palm.
It's like a real ancient killing god, shooting a bloody giant palm towards the mortal world, intending to destroy all worlds.
At this moment, Fang Xuan actually felt a life and death crisis.
If he can't catch this blow, he will die!
It's not that he failed in the challenge, but that everything about him, including his body and soul, will completely disappear from the world.
Death in the true sense of the word.
Fang Xuan's heart beat.
That's the fear of death.
Can't get rid of it, can't suppress it.
This is the instinct of all living things.
When the bloody giant palm got closer and closer, Fang Xuan felt relieved.
He made no unnecessary moves.
He just raised his arm and punched upward.
Behind Fang Xuan, a figure of unparalleled splendor also condensed.
Shocking murderous intent filled all realms.
Compared with the body of the God of Death behind the white-haired Fang Xuan, the figure behind Fang Xuan is the real God of Death.
Take charge of the way of killing!
This is exactly the phantom of the Killing Goddess Empress that Fang Xuan drew up based on the white-haired Fang Xuan's thoughts.
Fang Xuan seemed to be integrated with the phantom of the Killing Goddess Empress. They all raised their hands and punched out.
"The God of Death is coming!"
With one punch, the situation changed color and blood and thunder fell.
The bloody giant palm dissipated inch by inch like snow melted by the scorching sun.
The mountain of bones was directly crushed.
The sea of ​​blood was also blasted into powder.
The dharma body behind the white-haired Fang Xuan was punched into nothingness.
Heaven and earth are quiet.
On the plain, Fang Xuan and white-haired Fang Xuan looked at each other.
"Failed."
The white-haired Fang Xuan sighed, glanced at Fang Xuan, said something meaningful, and then slowly dissipated.
"I'm waiting for you in front."
The moment the white-haired Fang Xuan disappeared, blood poured into Fang Xuan's body one after another, washing away Fang Xuan's limbs and bones.
"Crack!"
Until a certain moment.
